profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
- Experience

Game Software Programmer With More Than 10 years Experience and 5 Commercial Games.

- Destination

To create Innovative, Twinkling, Surprising Games.

- Favorite Games

World of Warcraft, Warcraft 1-2-3, League of Legends, Final Fantasy 10, Home World

Specialties: Game Client Architecture Design and Programming. Graphics Programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* CPU/GPU Performance and Memory analysis on games for Apple Platforms.
* Providing support to the game developers on performance/quality issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Porting games to various platforms including Mac OSX, iOS, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4.

- performance analysis and optimization for CPU/GPU.
- fixing visual artifacts and bugs in rendering pipeline/shaders.
- working on different Graphics APIs for porting games to various target platforms.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Working on multi platform games with various engines, implementing gameplay/graphics features, fixing bugs, performance analysis/optimization.

positions.title: Programmer/Game Designer/Music Composer
positions.description:
2D Puzzle Game for iPhone, iPad('GemMonster', iOS, Cocos2D)
- Entire Game Design
- Entire Game Programming
- Publishing via AppStore
- Facebook/Game Center Score 
- Based on Cocos2D Engine
- Supports every iOS devices(also Retina Display)
- Composed BGM using GarageBand
- iAD support
- Play Video : http://youtu.be/UIBmG9C2eKg

positions.title: Programming Team Manager
positions.description:
MMORPG Client Programming('Project Name : East', 3D, Windows, Gamebryo Lightspeed 3.1, PhysX)

< Client System Design And Implementation >
- Client Architecture Design
- Client Core System Design and Implementation
- Character Action System(sort of state machine)  Design and Implementation

< 3rd Party Engine Integration >
- Path Egnine
- SpeedTree Engine
- PhysX Engine
- Scaleform Engine

< Graphics Programming >
- Screen Space Ambient Occlusion
- Deferred Lighting
- Linear Space Lighting
- Rim Lighting
- Refraction(Water, Effect)
- Bloom
- Depth of Field
- Metal Material
- Full Screen Motion Blur and Radial Blur
- 3DS Max Gamebryo Plugin Upgrade
- SpeedTree Shader Upgrade.

< Graphics Optimization >
- Occlusion Culling using DirectX Query API.
- Optimization based on the distance from camera.
- Gamebryo Shadow System Optimization

< Tool Programming >
- Max Plugin Improvement.
- World Building Tool(Map Tool) Improvement.

< Programming Team Management(4 client, 3 server) >
- Schedule Management
- Communication with other department(Artist, Designer...)
- Job Interview

positions.title: Client Lead Programmer
positions.description:
Action MMORPG Client Programming( 'Dragonica', 3D, Windows, C++, Gamebryo, DirectX, PhysX)
- Client System Design
- Character Action System
- Graphics Optimization and Improvement
- Game Contents Programming
- LUA as a script language

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Mobile RealTime Strategy Game Programming( 'Amazing Wars', 2D, Java)
- Entire game software design and programming
- Optimized A*

positions.title: Client Lead Programmer
positions.description:
MMORPG client programming( 'Talesweaver,' 2D, Windows, DirectX, C++)
- Entire client system design and programming(graphics, UI, gameplay, communication, sound ... )

positions.title: Associate Client Programmer
positions.description:
Role Playing Game Programming('Elysion', Scenario Based, Semi 3D(Character : Billboard, Background : Mesh), Windows, DirectX)

- Graphics Improvement
- Character Skill System Improvement
- Game Contents Programming

certifications.name: Improving Deep Neural Networks: Hyperparameter tuning, Regularization and Optimization
certifications.title: Improving Deep Neural Networks: Hyperparameter tuning, Regularization and Optimization

projects.title: Porting 'Brothers - a Tales of Two Sons' to NextGen(PS4/XB1)
projects.description:
* Porting the game from current gen(PS3, XB360, PC) to NextGen Consoles(XB1, PS4).
  - Fixing various graphics bugs for XB1, PS4.
  - Implementing various features for XB1, PS4 certification.

projects.title: Porting Star Wars: Knights of The Old Republic to Nintendo Switch
projects.description: Porting Star Wars:KOTOR to Nintendo Switch. Designed/implemented the graphics API translation layer. Performance optimizations.
